issue: Rapier 0.19.3 import used the obsolete rapier.es.js path and returned 404.
fix: Use the installed package's rapier.mjs entry point.

issue: The sector banner overflowed the phone viewport.
fix: Scale mobile sector lettering with viewport width.

issue: The flagship holding point put most of its hull beyond the top of the camera, and the boss gauge overlapped its approach.
fix: Bring the encounter holding point closer, frame farther upstream with more vertical room, and give the boss gauge the center header area.

issue: A fast burst tap could occur entirely between rendered input polls and never reach the authoritative host.
fix: Latch keyboard action presses until sampled, then retain transient actions until the next network input packet.

issue: A client debrief could retain the receiving-flight-plan overlay after the host disconnected, blocking mouse access to its return button.
fix: Clear the waiting overlay and combat overlays when the flight leader leaves.
